title: United Would Rather Fly Empty Seats, Flydubai Pulls Out of 24 Cities, and Delta's Own Airport Hands United the Keys
summary: United's CCO just admitted the airline is fine leaving seats empty if it means higher fares — we break down what that actually means for your ticket price. Plus, Flydubai slashes two dozen destinations as the Middle East conflict keeps squeezing Gulf carriers, United quietly takes over most of the new gates at Delta's own Salt Lake City fortress hub, Etihad launches a genuinely weird nonstop to Calgary that makes total sense once you hear the reason, and a new survey says most European pilots have literally fallen asleep at the controls.
